title: hotfix: fix SLO enforcement + circuit breaker load-shedding on regional failover
author: Nikhil Rao
description: Urgent hotfix for SLO enforcement and regional failover edge-case where the circuit breaker and load-shedding logic failed to transition in high-latency regional outages. Root cause: inconsistent region key normalization between the SLO evaluation path and the circuit state store which allowed stale per-region state to bypass threshold checks during traffic redistribution. This caused downstream overload and client-facing 502 spikes during a recent incident. This PR: normalizes region/route keys, makes per-region circuit state updates atomic, adds queue-length based soft backpressure to the gateway, adds token-estimate based load-shedding when backend latency SLOs are violated, improves metrics (per-region latency histogram, circuit_state changes, shed_count), and hardens the failover path so that when a region is marked degraded the gateway will immediately apply shedding rules instead of relying on stale cache entries. Also adds unit and integration tests that reproduce the failure mode, updates configs for default shed thresholds, adds a short rollout plan and dashboard links, and includes a follow-up TODO to remove a temporary compatibility flag. This description includes files changed, commits, review thread summary, and CI outcomes below.
commits: fix: region key normalization in slo_enforcer.go
fix: atomic update for region circuit state and tests
feat: gateway: add queue-length soft backpressure and shedding logic
test: add integration test that simulates regional latency spike and failover
docs: rollout notes and dashboard links

--- a/services/gateway/load_shed.go +++ b/services/gateway/load_shed.go @@ -45,6 +45,32 @@ func shouldShed(queueLen int, estTokens int, region string) bool { + // apply soft backpressure first based on queue length + if queueLen > cfg.Backpressure.QueueSoftLimit { +  return true + } + // token-estimate shedding when SLO violation detected + if estTokens > cfg.Shed.MaxEstimatedTokensPerReq && regionState.IsDegraded(region) { +  return true + } + return false +}

release_notes: Hotfix: Resolve case where circuit breaker failed to trigger during regional latency spikes leading to downstream overload. Adds region key normalization, atomic circuit updates, gateway soft backpressure, and token-estimate load-shedding. Improves metrics and dashboards.
